status: Weather snapshot bundled; other sources are optional candidates, not installed evidence

sources.name: Open-Meteo / Copernicus ERA5 historical weather
sources.purpose: Regional rain-day counts and adjustable wet-weather exposure scenarios
sources.join: suburb-centre coordinates → returned ERA5 grid; day, scenario start and as-of cutoff
sources.storage: 10,960 daily values in 5 unique grids; 10 suburb mappings, 2020–2025
sources.boundary: Approximately 25 km gridded reanalysis, not a site gauge. Rainfall thresholds, recovery days and lost hours are explicit uncalibrated assumptions; actual lost workdays are not recorded. Attribution: Open-Meteo and Copernicus/ECMWF ERA5, CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: CSIRO / ACLEP ASRIS National Soil Grids
sources.purpose: Regional soil order and mapped clay screening, 0–30 cm
sources.join: 10 real suburb-centre point queries, layer IDs and depth interval
sources.storage: Optional adapter; no source observations are distributed with this release
sources.status: Not bundled in the public release; verify source-specific reuse terms before importing
sources.boundary: Not a geotechnical investigation at a fictional site. Map resolution and survey age are not established here. Does not establish rock, contamination, treatment cost or recovery time.

sources.name: Bureau of Meteorology Climate Data Online
sources.purpose: Historical rainfall and temperature; multi-year seasonal baselines
sources.join: station coordinates, site distance, observation date, publication date
sources.storage: numeric time series, not embedded daily values
sources.boundary: Observed future work-period weather cannot be quote-time evidence. Rainfall does not itself establish a lost working day.

sources.name: Geoscience Australia ELVIS
sources.join: site polygon, dataset footprint, capture date, resolution
sources.storage: external raster/object storage plus spatial metadata
sources.boundary: Does not establish designed cut/fill volume or replace a site survey.

sources.name: CSIRO Soil and Landscape Grid of Australia
sources.purpose: Regional soil attributes and screening context
sources.join: site coordinates, grid cell, model version, depth interval
sources.storage: spatial attributes plus linked metadata documents
sources.boundary: Modelled regional data is not a site-specific geotechnical investigation or proof of excavatable rock.

sources.name: Queensland soil mapping
sources.purpose: Soil maps and acid sulfate screening
sources.storage: spatial metadata and searchable source descriptions
sources.boundary: A screening flag prompts a question; it does not classify spoil or establish a treatment cost.

sources.name: Australian Institute of Petroleum terminal gate prices
sources.storage: Optional adapter; no source observations are distributed with this release
sources.boundary: Inclusive-of-GST numeric observations with workbook cell references. Wholesale terminal averages are not delivered costs; fuel-only scenario requires a user-supplied litre allowance. Later snapshot is not proof of quote-time data vintage.
sources.status: Not bundled in the public release; verify source-specific reuse terms before importing

sources.name: Queensland waste levy rates
sources.purpose: Date-effective levy context for classified disposal scenarios
sources.join: effective financial year, waste classification, origin and destination zones
sources.storage: versioned structured rate table and supporting rules
sources.boundary: Levy is not the landfill gate fee; exemptions, material classification, destination acceptance and GST require confirmation. No rates imported.

sources.name: National Heavy Vehicle Regulator National Network Map
sources.join: route geometry, vehicle configuration, effective date
sources.boundary: Map access and routing integrations are not implemented; generated distances are explicitly simulated proxies.

sources.name: ABS Producer Price Indexes
sources.join: appropriate series and geography, reference quarter, release date
sources.storage: numeric series with series ID and release vintage
sources.boundary: No single series is an exact earthworks inflation factor. Avoid double counting fuel and broad inflation adjustments.

calendar_features.supplier_shutdowns: fictional vendor-specific dates, never assumed universal

pricing_policy: Context does not automatically become a price multiplier. Use it to retrieve comparable cases, surface questions or support an explicitly sourced scenario adjustment.
